name: Flower Chimera

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Access Tian Xia origin

---
You call on a guardian of the wild to burst forth from the land to aid you. You can cast Spiritual Guardian as a 5th-rank innate primal spell once per day, even if you don't have a deity; this guardian manifests as a kami or other nature spirit. When you reach 17th level, you can heighten this spell to 7th rank.
